copy.blurb: For now, the model and The Market agree on Jordan versus Algeria to within a point on every side — and 'for now' is the operative phrase. The inputs that usually separate two numbers — the confirmed eleven, fresh injury and fitness news, weather at the venue — haven't landed yet, so today there's nothing pulling the prior away from the price. That makes Pass the correct read today, not a permanent one. The model's three-way (18% / 17% / 65%) sits on top of the market's shape. The engine refreshes as kickoff nears; if news moves enough of the prior, this can turn into a Pick. Until then, there's no gap to show.
